Name: No Hands Auto-Petter
Author: BucketListMod
Description:
I thought I briefly saw a mod on here that changed the Auto-Petter from creepy hands to a scratching brush. I then could find no evidence such a mod ever actually existed. So I made it myself because I don't like the auto-petter hands.

Currently futsing with trying to figure out how/if I can change it from a rotating brush to a stationary one that wobbles like the Heater and adding that as a config option. Currently unable to figure out how, so for now it is a simple image replacer.

Manifest.Name: No Hands Auto-Petter
Manifest.Description: Replaces the Auto-Petter assets to be less creepy but still very Joja.
Manifest.Author: BucketList
